title: Add built‑in body‑parser middleware with size limits and error handling
description: Provides native support for parsing JSON, URL‑encoded, and raw request bodies without external dependencies. Enforces configurable size limits and returns standardized errors, simplifying API development and keeping the framework zero‑dependency.
testCases: Parse a valid JSON payload and verify req.body contains the object
Reject a JSON payload exceeding the configured size limit with a 413 response
Return a 400 error for malformed JSON payload
Parse a valid URL‑encoded payload and verify req.body fields
Parse a raw buffer payload when content‑type is application/octet-stream
acceptance: The framework exposes app.use(bodyParser({json:{limit:'1mb'},urlencoded:{limit:'500kb'},raw:{limit:'2mb'}})). All tests pass, valid bodies are attached to req.body, oversized bodies trigger a 413 response, and malformed JSON triggers a 400 response with a clear error message.
reason: Body parsing is a core requirement for most APIs. Providing a built‑in, zero‑dependency solution removes the need for external packages, reduces bundle size, and aligns with yantraverse's stability and production‑ready goals.
